title: Donald Trump hosts Xi Jinping for state dinner with tech titans. Follow live.
summary: Donald Trump rolled out the red carpet for Chinese leader Xi Jinping, with the two having toasted each other at a lavish state dinner after their summit meeting. America's top tech bosses were also…

blocks.text: Protesters gather in downtown Washington to protest Xi's visit

blocks.caption: Some protesters called for greater freedoms and autonomy in TibetImage: Kent Nishimura/AFP

blocks.text: A few hundred protesters gathered near the White House to rally against Xi Jinping's visit to the US.
Protesters highlighted a number of issues, from calls for religious freedom and autonomy in Tibet, Hong Kong and the Xinjiang region to demands that China refrain from interfering in Taiwan.
Protesters gathered in Lafayette Park, north of the White House, while other groups gathered outside the Chinese embassy. Pro-Xi rallies were also held in Washington.
